name: Hollow Crown
description: A fierce young blue star barely three hundred million years alight, wearing its birth dust like a crown. Two close worlds bake in ultraviolet glare while comets fall through untouched. Nothing here is older than the light it gives.

stars.name: Hollow Crown Fire
stars.description: A blue-white giant of a star, young and brilliant and utterly indifferent. Its ultraviolet output sterilizes everything unshielded. The birth disk still glows around it in infrared.

planets.name: Glareward
planets.description: A nitrogen-ice world kept from freezing by the ferocious primary alone. Geysers erupt where the ultraviolet strikes hardest. Its sky burns blue even at midnight from scattered glare.

planets.name: Anvil
planets.description: A basalt rock annealed by ultraviolet into glassy plains. Impact melt sheets glitter across whole hemispheres. Shielded vaults below hold gene banks against the sterilizing sky.

comets.name: First Snow
comets.description: A pristine long-period comet falling inward for the first time since formation. Its unprocessed ice predates the planets themselves. Samplers wait at perihelion like mourners at a birth.
